findings.issue: R1 finding #1 NOT resolved. Tech-spec Acceptance Criteria 'Outage state machine' (line 446) still demands 'All 12 state transitions from code-research §14.4 covered by tests (5 states × triggers)'. Task 5 AC line 61 still reads 'Все 4 ключевых перехода ... покрыты тестами' and TDD Anchor still lists only 6 tests covering 4 explicit transitions. The 'no-op' branches (ping_1_sent + outage error AND now-t0 < 1h → stays at ping_1_sent, no pings; ping_2_sent + outage error AND now-t0 < 2h → stays at ping_2_sent, no pings) and recovery_pending state probes are not anchored as tests. The transition table embedded in the task (lines 115–122) lists only 6 rows, not the 12 the tech-spec calls for — the gap is structural, not just textual.
findings.fix: Either (a) bring task 5 in line with tech-spec AC: add TDD anchor entries (and matching AC line) for the no-op branches, recovery_pending probe rate-limit via last_health_check_at, recovery from google_fallback_active, recovery_event when outage_started_at IS NULL, and any other rows that make up the '12 transitions × 5 states' count from §14.4 — bring the test inventory to ~10–12 transition tests; OR (b) reconcile tech-spec to '6 transitions' if §14.4 indeed enumerates only 6, and update the AC line to match. Pick one source of truth — the discrepancy itself is the bug.
